description: This file defines the ShoppingCartService interface, which specifies methods for operations related to shopping cart management, such as retrieving, saving, deleting, merging shopping carts, and creating shipping products.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieves the shopping cart associated with a given customer.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new shopping cart or updates an existing one.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart by its ID and associated merchant store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart based on a specific code and merchant store.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a shopping cart for a specified customer.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Creates a list of shipping products from the shopping cart items.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Checks if the shopping cart or its items are free of charge.

methods.name: populateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Populates a shopping cart item from a product and attributes.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Removes a shopping cart, possibly from session or other storage.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merges two shopping carts into a single cart for a user.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Determines if the shopping cart requires shipping based on its contents.
